description:
Returns a quote's status, what is missing, and the prices once ready: prices from multiple
    carriers cheapest first. Use it to answer "what would my insurance cost" or "am I overpaying".

    Status values: collecting, queued, rating, needs_info, in_review, done, failed.
    When done, results lists carriers cheapest first per line, a results_url for the shopper,
    a disclaimer and, for home, a flood notice that belong with the prices.
name: get_quote_status
title: Get quote status and prices
